chose: After home's 429, the pace adds home's Retry-After between requests (at most doubling the gap each time, at most a minute apart, its burst as much smaller) and keeps that for a day across page loads, then goes back to one each 2 s.
options: learn from Retry-After, kept a day
learn from Retry-After for the page load only
never learn: wait out each 429 and go on at one each 2 s
gray: How long the phone stays slower after home turned it away is felt as how quickly a pull finishes, and no check or earlier decision says it; never learning leaves a home whose limit is under the pace refusing most requests, and each lane's run failing part way, for as long as the app is open.
undo: Set LEARNED_MS in apps/www/src/lib/home-link/pace.ts, or pass null to pace.spend in runtime.ts's heardBusy to stop learning.
